articles.title: Article: Local-First AI Inference: A Cloud Architecture Pattern for Cost-Effective Document Processing
articles.reason: This article details a proven architecture pattern for reducing Azure OpenAI costs and improving efficiency in document processing, with measured outcomes and a clear workflow that can be adapted for finance or insurance clients.
articles.summary: The Local-First AI Inference pattern demonstrates how to offload the majority of document extraction to local deterministic methods, only escalating complex or uncertain cases to Azure OpenAI and human review. The architecture is directly relevant for building cost-effective, scalable RAG or agentic workflows in regulated enterprise environments.
